title: Replication package: Who Controls Agentic Payments? Facilitator Concentration, Subsidy Pipelines, and Settlement Accountability in x402
description: SQL, raw query results, the facilitator attribution census, concentration recompute scripts, dated external-anchor captures and the published figures for the C4 agentic-payments control-layer measurement. Every number in the paper reproduces from these artifacts plus public on-chain data. The orchestration and capture-attestation apparatus is withheld and bears on no measurement.
